title: Builder Signals · 2026-11-23
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 23 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie endorsed a post on why the AI-assisted Riemann Hypothesis breakthrough matters beyond math. The quoted piece calls it "not theory-building in the usual sense" but a "wormhole" requiring a 25,000-page tour through existing infrastructure with no obvious connection to the goal — beyond any human brain alone, and beyond any current AI alone too. Levie's point: problem-solving used to be bounded by how much information a person or team could retain; AI decouples human context limits from discovery…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 转发并力挺一篇解读「AI 攻克黎曼猜想」的文章，认为其意义远超数学本身。文章引语指出：这种证明不是传统的理论构建，而是一条需要穿越 25,000 页既有成果、与目标毫无明显关联的“虫洞”——没有任何人脑能独立完成，但目前的 AI 单独也做不到。Levie 的核心判断是：过去解决问题受限于个人或团队能记住和理解的信息量，AI 第一次把人的上下文上限与生产力/发现能力解耦；任何先前的研究、决策、无关突破都可能被用来创造新东西，从网络安全到生命科学，Agent 可以扫描企业里每一份数据去解决问题。解法也许不再优雅，但数量会多得多——这是质变而非小幅提升。

featured.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队
featured.summaryEn: Thariq, formerly on Claude Code at Anthropic, pushed back on the urge to remove humans from the loop. Yes, Claude does much of the technical work, and future models might one-shot "prove the Riemann hypothesis" or "make JavaScript a static language" — but collaborating with models to push the frontier is a deeply technical skill in its own right. As models get more powerful, that skill matters more, and he hasn't seen diminishing returns yet. His worry: we are too quick to disintermediate ourselves, doing both our…
featured.insightZh: 前 Claude Code 团队成员 Thariq 同样借黎曼猜想话题发表了一段反思：是的，Claude 在做大量技术工作，也许未来模型能一键“证明黎曼猜想”或“把 JavaScript 变成静态语言”，但他认为与模型协作推进前沿本身就是一门深度技术技能。随着模型越强，这项技能反而越重要，他至今没看到边际收益递减。他担心人们太急于把自己“去中介化”，这样既亏待了自己，也亏待了模型。

featured.title: Powering AI-Driven Drug Discovery with Isomorphic Labs President Max Jaderberg
featured.summaryEn: Isomorphic Labs' north star is to move drug discovery onto a computer — getting simulation models to experimental accuracy so the real world is used to validate, not to iterate, and toxicity and off-target problems are caught before drugs reach patients. Max Jaderberg, President and founding team member of Isomorphic Labs, came from DeepMind's AlphaGo/AlphaStar era after selling his computer-vision company to DeepMind in 2014. AlphaFold proved deep learning could generalize in biology, giving the team conviction to start Isomorphic in 2021. The host notes that despite a 10–20x explosion in papers and new modalities, new drug approvals per year are flat while cost per drug has climbed to ~$1.5B and timelines to ~15 years. Jaderberg blames the empirical trial-and-error nature of drug-making in hugely high-dimensional spaces, which only picks low-hanging fruit, and the fact that each progr…
featured.insightZh: Isomorphic Labs 的北极星是把药物发现“搬上计算机”——让模拟模型达到实验级精度，真实世界只用于验证而不是试错，从而在临床前就预见毒性与脱靶问题。 Max Jaderberg 是 Isomorphic Labs 总裁和创始团队成员，出身 DeepMind（AlphaGo、AlphaStar 时代），2014 年把自己的计算机视觉公司卖给 DeepMind。他说 AlphaFold 证明了深度学习能在生物学的有意义空间里泛化，这给了团队 2021 年成立 Isomorphic 的信心。主持人指出：过去几十年论文量涨了 10–20 倍、药物模态激增，但每年新药获批数几乎持平，单药成本升至约 15 亿美元、周期拉长到 15 年。Jaderberg 认为根源是制药一直高度依赖经验试错：生物和分子设计空间都极高维，试错只能摘到“低垂的果实”；而且每个药物项目都像定制的前沿科研，学到的东西难以迁移到下一个，缺少研发上的规模效应。AI 平台的价值在于让每一个项目的经验沉淀进底层模型，形成复利。 方法上，Isomorphic 内部所有排行榜上都有一条“实验精度”虚线：模型一旦达到实验精度，就不需要再去真实世界做那一步（如用 AlphaFold 替代耗时数月的 X 射线晶体学）。药物失败主要发生在临床阶段——未预料的毒性、脱靶、靶点本身的副作用——机会在于进入人体前就理解这些。他指出大鼠对人类临床毒性的预测性大约只有 30%，未来可以结合体外指标、AI 预测模型、类器官与器官芯片直接建模人体毒性。数据方面，公开或药企存量数据往往是多年被动收集的副产品、偏差很大，因此他们自建数据，并看到了很好的数据 scaling law。自动化实验室要继续用，但物理反应和细胞培养时间有极限，所以要尽量“in silico”。 商业模式上，Isomorphic 不卖模型、不卖 token，只用自研引擎做药：一部分是自有管线（聚焦肿瘤、免疫与炎症，瞄准 KRAS 这类影响大量患者的“根节点”问题），一部分与药企合作攻克对方十几二十年没突破的难题。更精准、低毒的分子也可能让复杂的联合用药成为可…

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad highlighted a high schooler recompiling GTA6 to run on PC — and, more interestingly, using GitHub issues to coordinate tasks across agent swarms, which he floats as a possible new model for open source. He also announced that Amuse, built with Replit Missions, is now open source.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 注意到一个高中生正在把 GTA6 重新编译到 PC 上运行，而更有意思的是他用 GitHub issues 来给 Agent 集群分派和协调任务——Masad 认为这可能是开源协作的新模式。另外他宣布由 Replit Missions 构建的项目 Amuse 已经开源。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan wondered how long before a vibe-coded hobbyist PC port of GTA VI appears with all the hated design flaws removed — "could literally be a month or two with enough tokens." He also said he's been using a tool for about half the work in his software factory, calling it the best experience so far across desktop, mobile and cloud, and added that automating your own work is "so easy tbh."
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 也在聊 GTA VI：鉴于 AI 和玩家对 GTA VI 的诸多不满，他好奇多久会出现一个去掉所有被吐槽设计缺陷的“vibe coding”业余 PC 移植版——只要 token 足够，可能一两个月就行。他还说自己“软件工厂”约一半的工作已在用某个工具，是目前桌面、移动、云端三端体验最好的，并感叹“自动化自己的工作其实很容易”。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads Codex & ChatGPT at OpenAI, said the team is already preparing another big update and asked users how the previous day's ChatGPT/Codex desktop app update is going — what still needs attention and isn't quite there yet.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 透露团队已在准备下一个大更新，并公开征集反馈：昨天 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面应用更新后体验如何？哪些地方还需要关注、还不够到位？

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang said the new ChatGPT mobile app is very clean, but if you miss your Codex threads you have to go to the right-most tab and long-press to pin Codex to the bottom nav — "this isn't obvious at all." He also suggested the left-nav chat list should include recent local Codex threads, not just chat threads.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 评价新版 ChatGPT 移动端“非常干净”，但如果你想念 Codex 线程，需要去最右侧标签页长按，把 Codex 固定到底部导航栏——他直言这完全不直观。他还建议左侧导航的聊天列表应同时包含本地最近的 Codex 线程，而不只是聊天线程。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper shared a piece on benchmarks: they must choose what to measure and what to hold constant, so "numbers go up" doesn't always mean what you think. Another window, he argues, is looking in rich detail at how AI-pilled teams actually put model capabilities to work. He also mocked a take he expects to join the "everything that will be invented has been invented" patent officer in the hall of fame of bad technology takes.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 推荐了一篇关于 benchmark 的好文：基准测试必须选择测什么、固定什么，“数字上涨”未必是你以为的意思；另一个观察窗口是细看那些深度拥抱 AI 的团队如何在实践中使用模型能力。他还嘲讽某条科技观点，称其将与那位说“能发明的都已经发明了”的专利官员一起进入“糟糕技术判断名人堂”。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark VC Matt Turck posted his first Slush wrap-up: best startup conference, visually striking in a gothic dark-chic way, organized by students who are super pro, with conversations about the Russia threat next door "a whole vibe" — and conferences in non-tech hubs work well because people stay put. He also poked fun at people tweeting excitedly about AI solving the Riemann Hypothesis with no idea what it is.
items.insightZh: FirstMark VC Matt Turck 发了首份 Slush 总结：最好的创业大会，哥特暗黑风的视觉很惊艳，由学生组织却非常专业，关于（隔壁）俄罗斯威胁的讨论自成氛围；他还认为在非科技中心举办会议效果更好，因为大家会留在会场。另外他调侃了那些根本不懂黎曼猜想却兴奋转发“AI 解决黎曼猜想”的人。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx of Latent Space reacted sharply to certain providers being found secretly phoning home, asking whether there is any possible benign explanation.
items.insightZh: Latent Space 的 Swyx 对某些服务商被发现“偷偷回传数据（phoning home）”表达强烈不满，质问是否有任何善意的解释。
